articles.title_en: Actionable policy responses to disaster threats – A comparative study on resilience and sustainability in global cities
articles.title_cn: 应对灾害威胁的可操作政策响应——全球城市韧性与可持续性的比较研究
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the hypothesis that preventive urban policy responses to disaster threats are likely to play a positive role in the resilient development of cities, not only by strengthening disaster mitigation and response-related adjustment mechanisms, but also by enhancing sustainability and liveability in urban areas. The study aims to test whether pressing disaster challenges for large cities prompt responses that lead to more positive outcomes than in a ‘without situation’. We argue that the ‘Blessing in Disguise’ (BiD) hypothesis applies also to potential threats, and not just to actual disasters. In our empirical study, the development trajectories of 40 global cities – represented by the comprehensive GPCI database – are addressed from the perspective of six distinct main categories of performance variables (Economy, R&D, Liveability, Cultural Interaction, Accessibility, and Environment). The research seeks to explore the linkages between the various GPCI performance indicators and urban GDP at risk using correlation and multiple regression tools, while the systemic interactions among all variables are subsequently analysed by means of Social Network Analysis. The results highlight that the larger and poorer cities appear to be more threatened by natural disasters, while, for the wealthiest cities, manmade disasters are a more significant threat. Manmade threats also appear to be more linked to the main GPCI category scores; in particular, Economy, Cultural Interaction and, especially, R&D appear to be positively correlated with the magnitude of urban threats, while Liveability and Environment are less prominently (or negatively) influenced. Therefore, urban innovative policy response – in a broad sense – is an important driver of proactive resilience and positive sustainability outcomes. In conclusion, the governance of global cities should organically and strategically integrate resilience, sustainability and liveability as a common guide for short- and long-term urban development, by adopting targeted policies that anticipate and manage urban threats, from both a structural and non-structural perspective, so as to develop adaptive urban morphological and land-use functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文检验了这样一个假设：针对灾害威胁的预防性城市政策响应可能在城市的韧性发展中发挥积极作用，不仅通过加强减灾和响应相关的调整机制，还通过提升城市地区的可持续性和宜居性。本研究旨在测试大城市面临的紧迫灾害挑战是否促使产生比“无灾害情境”更积极结果的响应。我们认为，“因祸得福”（BiD）假设同样适用于潜在威胁，而不仅仅是实际灾害。在我们的实证研究中，以综合GPCI数据库为代表的40个全球城市的发展轨迹，从六个不同的主要绩效变量类别（经济、研发、宜居性、文化互动、可达性和环境）的角度进行了考察。研究旨在利用相关性和多元回归工具，探讨各GPCI绩效指标与城市GDP风险之间的关联，随后通过社会网络分析对所有变量之间的系统性相互作用进行分析。结果表明，较大且较贫困的城市似乎更容易受到自然灾害的威胁，而对于最富裕的城市，人为灾害是更显著的威胁。人为威胁似乎也与GPCI主要类别得分关联更强；特别是，经济、文化互动，尤其是研发，似乎与城市威胁的规模呈正相关，而宜居性和环境则受到较不显著（或负面）的影响。因此，城市创新政策响应——从广义上讲——是主动韧性和积极可持续性结果的重要驱动力。总之，全球城市的治理应从结构和非结构角度，通过采取有针对性的政策来预见和管理城市威胁，从而发展适应性的城市形态和土地利用功能，将韧性、可持续性和宜居性有机地、战略性地整合为短期和长期城市发展的共同指南。

articles.title_en: Photovoltaic power plant installation in the Tokyo metropolitan area, Japan, focusing on land use and regulatory ordinances
articles.title_cn: 日本东京都地区光伏电站安装：聚焦土地利用与监管条例
articles.abstract_en: The location of ground-mounted photovoltaic power plants (PVPPs) may be significantly associated with land use when regulated via ordinance. We examined the distribution of ground-mounted PVPPs with respect to land use and current regulatory ordinances. Multinomial logistic regression analysis and the Tobit model were used to investigate the Tokyo metropolitan area, Japan. The hypothesis on areas with PVPP regulations and where PVPPs were installed was investigated through a case study, including PVPPs of 50 kW or larger within 12,637 meshes. Landscape, industrial, urban, and rural areas were selected as key land-use categories in terms of regulatory ordinance and PVPP scale/accumulation. The results showed that landscape, urban, or rural areas were generally regulated with ordinances to protect landscape and residential environments while industrial areas had the most PVPP installations. Large-scale or accumulations of multiple PVPPs were more likely to be installed in industrial or rural areas, but less likely to be installed in urban and landscape areas. The findings suggest that rural areas, initially accepting PVPPs, had regulatory ordinances enacted as increasing installations led to concerns. For policymakers, establishing regulatory ordinances to control land use before large PVPP installations would be essential to adjust the relationships between PVPP business operators and residents.
articles.abstract_cn: 地面安装的光伏电站（PVPPs）的位置在通过条例进行监管时，可能与土地利用显著相关。我们考察了地面安装的光伏电站在土地利用和现行监管条例方面的分布情况。采用多项逻辑回归分析和Tobit模型对日本东京都地区进行了研究。通过案例研究，包括在12,637个网格内装机容量为50千瓦及以上的光伏电站，探讨了有光伏电站监管条例且已安装光伏电站的区域的假设。景观区、工业区、城市区和农村区被选为在监管条例和光伏电站规模/累积方面的关键土地利用类别。结果表明，景观区、城市区或农村区通常通过条例进行监管以保护景观和居住环境，而工业区的光伏电站安装最多。大型或多个光伏电站的累积更可能安装在工业区或农村区，但不太可能安装在城市区和景观区。研究结果表明，最初接受光伏电站的农村地区，随着安装量的增加引发担忧，已颁布了监管条例。对于政策制定者而言，在大型光伏电站安装之前建立监管条例以控制土地利用，对于调整光伏电站运营商与居民之间的关系至关重要。

articles.title_en: Ambiguity in state-owned land property rights increases transaction costs in China’s transit-oriented development projects
articles.title_cn: 国有土地产权模糊性增加中国公交导向开发项目交易成本
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides compelling evidence that the ambiguity in state-owned land property rights increases transaction costs in China’s transit-oriented development (TOD) projects. The constitution defines the state as the de jure (legally defined) owner of urban land, but tiers of local government share the de facto (practically controlled) land property rights; this ambiguity complicates land use right transfer for TOD. Through expert interviews, document analysis, and case studies in Guangzhou, we identified three critical issues. First, ambiguity in de facto land property rights has led district governments to relocate the metro depot site from a profitable plot suitable for metro scheduling and property development to land plots that are less advantageous and far away from the station. Second, the coexistence of land allocation and leasing approaches under state ownership discouraged an optimised land assembly for the TOD project. Rigid acquisition sizes designated in land allocation for infrastructure discouraged coordination and prolonged negotiations between the district government and the metro company. Finally, the district government faced a disproportionate fiscal responsibility compared to their land leasing share from the municipal government. They are thus passively against the TOD project using their land use planning power. These transaction costs delay the TOD project and jeopardise the outcomes, resulting in depots far from metro stations, housing adjacent to industrial areas, and oversized commercial spaces on urban fringes. We argue that the ambiguity in state-owned land property rights is rooted in China’s historical, cultural, and institutional contexts, driving high transaction costs for urban infrastructure development.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了有力证据，表明国有土地产权的模糊性增加了中国公交导向开发（TOD）项目的交易成本。宪法将国家定义为城市土地的法定（法律定义上的）所有者，但各级地方政府共享事实上的（实际控制中的）土地产权；这种模糊性使TOD的土地使用权转移复杂化。通过专家访谈、文件分析和广州案例研究，我们识别出三个关键问题。首先，事实上的土地产权模糊性导致区政府将地铁车辆段选址从适合地铁调度和物业开发的盈利地块迁移至优势较小且远离车站的地块。其次，国有制下土地划拨与出让方式的并存阻碍了TOD项目的最优土地整合。基础设施土地划拨中规定的刚性收购规模阻碍了区政府与地铁公司之间的协调，并延长了谈判。最后，与市政府给予的土地出让份额相比，区政府面临不成比例的财政责任。因此，他们利用土地使用规划权力被动反对TOD项目。这些交易成本延误了TOD项目并损害了成果，导致车辆段远离地铁站、住宅毗邻工业区以及城市边缘商业空间过大。我们认为，国有土地产权的模糊性根植于中国的历史、文化和制度背景，推高了城市基础设施开发的高交易成本。

articles.title_en: Housebuilders’ landbanks: Inventory, asset or hoard?
articles.title_cn: 房屋建筑商的土地储备：库存、资产还是囤积？
articles.abstract_en: In the context of longstanding allegations of land hoarding and/or speculation, this paper examines the land holdings of major housebuilders. The paper discusses the concept of landbanking and potential motives for and consequences of holding land inventories. Through a descriptive analysis of quantitative, temporal data of the landbanks of leading, listed housebuilders, the paper analyses the land holdings of residential developers in both the US and UK. The analysis encompasses various aspects including the relative scale of their land holdings, the extent of land ownership compared to control (typically through options) and the evolution of these patterns over time. It is found that the main motives for holding significant land inventories could be operational, investment or anti-competitive but that holding land also comes with opportunity costs and risks. Despite operating in a highly imperfect land market and restrictive planning regime, the large UK housebuilders have been able to maintain significant and relatively stable landbanks. In comparison, the US has seen a major shift towards land-light strategies. US housebuilders increasingly rely upon relatively short-term options, rather than outright land ownership, to secure their pipeline of development plots. The shift primarily aims to hedge risks associated with holding land. Although the comparative evidence is limited and imperfect, it generally indicates that UK housebuilders tend to maintain smaller land inventories compared to their counterparts in the US, Australia, and Ireland.
articles.abstract_cn: 在长期存在的土地囤积和/或投机指控的背景下，本文考察了主要房屋建筑商的土地持有情况。本文讨论了土地储备的概念以及持有土地库存的潜在动机和后果。通过对领先的上市房屋建筑商土地储备的定量、时间数据的描述性分析，本文分析了美国和英国住宅开发商的土地持有情况。分析涵盖了多个方面，包括其土地持有的相对规模、土地所有权与控制权（通常通过期权）的程度以及这些模式随时间的变化。研究发现，持有大量土地库存的主要动机可能是运营性、投资性或反竞争性的，但持有土地也伴随着机会成本和风险。尽管在高度不完善的土地市场和限制性的规划制度下运营，英国的大型房屋建筑商仍能维持显著且相对稳定的土地储备。相比之下，美国则出现了向轻土地策略的重大转变。美国房屋建筑商越来越依赖相对短期的期权，而非直接的土地所有权，来确保其开发地块的管道。这一转变主要旨在对冲持有土地相关的风险。尽管比较证据有限且不完善，但总体上表明，与美国的同行相比，英国房屋建筑商倾向于维持较小的土地库存，而澳大利亚和爱尔兰的情况则有所不同。

articles.title_en: Assessing the impact of urbanization and forest aging on carbon absorption in the Seoul metropolitan area of South Korea
articles.title_cn: 评估韩国首尔都市区城市化与森林老化对碳吸收的影响
articles.abstract_en: In response to the escalating climate crisis, this study examined the dynamics of carbon absorption in the Seoul metropolitan area, focusing on the effects of urbanization and forest aging. Urban areas face increasing challenges due to climate change, necessitating a deeper understanding of how land-use changes and natural forest aging impact carbon sequestration. We assessed the spatial distribution and carbon absorption capacity of forests by categorizing the regions into urban centers, clusters, and non-urban areas. Using data from the Korea Forest Service and the National Forest Research Institute of Korea, we analyzed carbon absorption in 2013 and 2022, revealing significant shifts driven primarily by land use changes and forest aging. The results showed that urbanization led to a notable reduction in carbon absorption, with new city developments and unplanned expansions converting carbon-rich natural areas into artificial landscapes. Aging forests exhibit a decline in carbon sequestration, highlighting the need for sustainable forest management practices. This study highlighted the importance of tailoring city-specific strategies to enhance carbon absorption. This provides insights for policymakers to balance development with conservation efforts, ultimately contributing to more effective climate change mitigation in urban regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 为应对日益加剧的气候危机，本研究考察了首尔都市区碳吸收的动态变化，重点关注城市化和森林老化的影响。城市地区因气候变化面临日益严峻的挑战，因此需要更深入地理解土地利用变化和自然森林老化如何影响碳封存。我们将区域划分为城市中心、城市群和非城市区域，评估了森林的空间分布和碳吸收能力。利用韩国森林服务局和韩国国家森林科学研究所的数据，我们分析了2013年和2022年的碳吸收情况，揭示了主要由土地利用变化和森林老化驱动的显著变化。结果表明，城市化导致碳吸收显著减少，新城市开发和计划外扩张将富含碳的自然区域转变为人工景观。老化森林的碳封存能力下降，凸显了可持续森林管理实践的必要性。本研究强调了制定针对具体城市策略以增强碳吸收的重要性，为政策制定者平衡发展与保护提供了见解，最终有助于更有效地缓解城市地区的气候变化。

articles.title_en: Limits to local democracy in practice? The case of governing sustainable land use in Norwegian municipalities
articles.title_cn: 地方民主实践的局限？挪威市政可持续土地利用治理案例
articles.abstract_en: The article investigates governance processes’ performance in securing sustainable land use in Norwegian municipalities, drawing on a survey sent out to decision-makers combined with in-depth interviews with decision-makers and local stakeholders. Local governance processes have to date been unsuccessful in securing environmentally sustainable land use in the investigated municipalities for several reasons. First, environmental concerns lose out in goal conflicts with competing societal concerns. Second, the gradual character of processes building down nature makes it difficult to recognise the accumulated environmental cost. Third, forces beyond municipal control drive a certain kind of development at the expense of nature. Fourth, there is limited power and capacity in the land use planning system to govern effectively. Finally, there are inequities in the capacity and power of individual actors to influence local land use, putting the commons and key democratic principles under pressure. The article points to several challenges in the current model of local land use governance when it comes to securing legitimacy and environmental justice, most importantly the issue of current institutions and practices empowering the already powerful, at the expense of the natural resources the system is supposed to safeguard. The discussion questions the ability of the current model of governance to secure environmentally sustainable land use and suggests ways in which land use governance may be changed to better secure sustainable land use.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于对决策者的问卷调查及对决策者和地方利益相关者的深度访谈，考察了挪威市政中确保可持续土地利用的治理过程绩效。在所调查的市政中，地方治理过程迄今未能成功确保环境可持续的土地利用，原因有几点。首先，在与竞争性社会关切的目标冲突中，环境关切处于劣势。其次，逐步侵蚀自然的渐进过程使得累积的环境成本难以被识别。第三，市政控制之外的力量以牺牲自然为代价推动了某种类型的发展。第四，土地利用规划系统在有效治理方面的权力和能力有限。最后，个体行动者影响地方土地利用的能力和权力存在不平等，这给公共资源和关键民主原则带来了压力。文章指出了当前地方土地利用治理模式在确保合法性和环境正义方面面临的若干挑战，最重要的是现行制度和实践增强了本已强大者的权力，却以系统本应保护的自然资源为代价。讨论质疑了当前治理模式确保环境可持续土地利用的能力，并提出了改变土地利用治理以更好地确保可持续土地利用的途径。

articles.title_en: Understanding organic agriculture based on coupled human-earth systems for sustainable land use and rural development in China
articles.title_cn: 基于人地耦合系统的中国有机农业理解：面向可持续土地利用与农村发展
articles.abstract_en: Organic agriculture is recognized as a nature-based innovative production system that balances multiple sustainable development goals. However, few studies were conducted to investigate organic agriculture based on coupled human-earth systems. Here we introduced a hierarchical framework consisting of natural basis, management means, and demand objectives to understand organic agriculture. We reported the spatiotemporal patterns of organic agriculture and their socioeconomic and eco-environmental correlates and effects in China. Our study showed that organic production increased from 1.124 to 2.756 million ha in 2014–2021 with the most increase in soybeans, corn, and tea. The number of organic product certificates was higher in northeastern, southwestern, and eastern coastal China, and the fastest-growing occurred in western and south-central China. Of the 14 factors, management means and demand objectives ranked by organic enterprises, organic demonstration areas, food consumptions, pesticide applications, and large-scale farming operations had greater influences on organic agriculture. The interaction of human-environmental factors enhanced their impact. Organic farming increased soil carbon sequestration and reduced greenhouse gas emissions compared with conventional farming. Although average organic yields and output values per unit area were lower by 10.5–61.7 % and 5.1–48.9 % respectively for most crops, higher yields of corn, soybeans, and tea, and output values of vegetables were achieved in organic farming. We suggest synergizing organic agricultural system management to foster sustainable land use and rural development.
articles.abstract_cn: 有机农业被认为是一种基于自然的创新生产系统，能够平衡多个可持续发展目标。然而，很少有研究基于人地耦合系统来探讨有机农业。在此，我们引入了一个由自然基础、管理手段和需求目标组成的层级框架来理解有机农业。我们报告了中国有机农业的时空格局及其社会经济和生态环境的相关性与影响。我们的研究表明，有机生产面积从1.124-2.756年的2014万公顷增加到2021万公顷，其中大豆、玉米和茶叶的增长最为显著。有机产品证书数量在中国东北、西南和东部沿海地区较高，而增长最快的是中国西部和中南部地区。在14个因素中，由有机企业、有机示范区、食品消费、农药施用和大规模农业经营排序的管理手段和需求目标对有机农业的影响更大。人-环境因素的交互作用增强了其影响。与传统农业相比，有机农业增加了土壤碳固存并减少了温室气体排放。尽管大多数作物的平均有机产量和单位面积产值分别低10.5-61.7%和5.1-48.9%，但有机农业中玉米、大豆和茶叶的产量以及蔬菜的产值实现了更高水平。我们建议协同有机农业系统管理，以促进可持续土地利用和农村发展。

articles.title_en: Advancing urban hub planning: A bibliometric analysis of concepts, effects evaluation, and spatial design
articles.title_cn: 推进城市枢纽规划：概念、效果评估与空间设计的文献计量分析
articles.abstract_en: Urban hubs play a pivotal role in advancing urban and transport sustainability. However, despite growing scholarly interest, existing research fails to provide a thorough understanding of their development and evolution. This study addresses this gap by analyzing 624 documents on urban hubs published between 2000 and 2024 through a bibliometric approach. The research synthesizes the concept of urban hubs, examines their effects, and reviews key design elements. It highlights how the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly influenced urban hub planning, particularly in location optimization and spatial design. Through a detailed literature review, the study identifies key research gaps, including the lack of quantitative methods to assess urban hubs’ impacts, the need for demographic and long-term health considerations, insufficient focus on environmental goals like resilience and low-carbon design, and the limited application of AI techniques in generating 3D spatial functions. The study proposes a comprehensive AI-driven research framework that integrates social, economic, and environmental factors to enhance urban hub planning. The findings provide valuable insights for policymakers and urban planners, offering a pathway for the future development of sustainable urban hubs.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市枢纽在推进城市和交通可持续性方面发挥着关键作用。然而，尽管学术兴趣日益增长，现有研究未能对其发展和演变提供全面的理解。本研究通过文献计量方法，分析了2000年至2024年间发表的624篇关于城市枢纽的文献，以填补这一空白。研究综合了城市枢纽的概念，考察了其效果，并回顾了关键设计要素。研究强调了人工智能（AI）的整合如何显著影响城市枢纽规划，特别是在位置优化和空间设计方面。通过详细的文献回顾，研究识别了关键的研究空白，包括缺乏评估城市枢纽影响的定量方法、需要纳入人口统计和长期健康考虑、对韧性和低碳设计等环境目标的关注不足，以及AI技术在生成三维空间功能方面的应用有限。研究提出了一个综合的AI驱动研究框架，整合社会、经济和环境因素以增强城市枢纽规划。研究结果为政策制定者和城市规划者提供了宝贵的见解，为可持续城市枢纽的未来发展提供了路径。

articles.title_en: Sustainable land use in Moldova: GIS & remote sensing of forests and crops
articles.title_cn: 摩尔多瓦可持续土地利用：森林与农作物的GIS与遥感分析
articles.abstract_en: Forests and agricultural lands are critical components of the environment, influencing ecosystem stability, biodiversity, and land productivity. In the Republic of Moldova, a country with limited forest cover (11.4 % of its territory), the relationship between forested areas and cultivated land plays a key role in sustainable land management. This study examines the spatial interactions between forest land and two major agricultural crops—sunflower (Helianthus annuus) and grapes (Vitis vinifera) - using remote sensing and GIS techniques. By integrating Google Earth Engine (GEE), CORINE Land Cover data, and cadastral records, we analyze land cover changes from 1996 to 2018, identifying vulnerable areas where deforestation and agricultural expansion intersect. Additionally, fuzzy aggregate AHP and zonal statistical methods are applied to assess land suitability for crop cultivation and reforestation. Our findings highlight regions where sustainable land management policies should be prioritized to balance agricultural development with forest conservation. The study provides actionable insights for policymakers, emphasizing the need for adaptive land-use strategies that account for climate variability, urban expansion, and rural land degradation.
articles.abstract_cn: 森林和农业用地是环境的关键组成部分，影响生态系统稳定性、生物多样性和土地生产力。在摩尔多瓦共和国，一个森林覆盖率有限（占其领土的11.4%）的国家，森林区域与耕地之间的关系在可持续土地管理中发挥着关键作用。本研究利用遥感和GIS技术，考察了森林用地与两种主要农作物——向日葵（Helianthus annuus）和葡萄（Vitis vinifera）——之间的空间相互作用。通过整合Google Earth Engine（GEE）、CORINE土地覆盖数据和地籍记录，我们分析了从1996年到2018年的土地覆盖变化，识别了森林砍伐与农业扩张交汇的脆弱区域。此外，应用模糊聚合AHP和分区统计方法评估作物种植和重新造林的适宜性。我们的研究结果突出了应优先实施可持续土地管理政策以平衡农业发展与环境森林保护的地区。该研究为政策制定者提供了可行的见解，强调需要采取适应性的土地利用策略，以应对气候变异性、城市扩张和农村土地退化。

articles.title_en: Measures to reduce land subsidence and greenhouse gas emissions in peatlands: A Dutch case study
articles.title_cn: 减少泥炭地地面沉降和温室气体排放的措施：荷兰案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Worldwide, peatlands suffer from land subsidence and greenhouse gas emissions due to artificial drainage inducing peat decomposition. Under anthropogenic climate change, these issues require measures to reduce the emission of greenhouse gases and protect low-lying areas from increasing flood risk. Tighter control of groundwater levels is required, both within existing agricultural systems and through the development of new agricultural systems suitable for farming under high groundwater levels or inundation. The complexity and value-laden nature of the issue warrants the development of a comprehensive overview of potential and side effects of measures. In this paper such an overview is synthesized based on a mixed-method approach for a special case, The Netherlands. The Dutch peatlands comprise extensive land areas in the low-lying west and north of The Netherlands. The case is exceptional as most of these peatlands lie below sea level, sustain world-class intensive dairy farming and are subject to multiple other environmental, economic and societal challenges. Here, land subsidence increases flood risk, salt-water intrusion and the costs of water management, particularly under global climate change. To mitigate land subsidence, both technical measures and alternative land uses can be envisaged. However, the literature about these is fragmented, complicating a careful identification and selection of measures. To address this knowledge gap, we review 27 technical measures and alternative land use options and synthesize evidence and insights for 15 effects. Technical measures allowing continuation of existing dairy farming provide relatively low-risk interventions for farmers, but will only reduce, not stop land subsidence and greenhouse gas emissions. Alternative land-use options, particularly paludiculture, are in a start-up stage of development and can stop land subsidence. However, more research is required to reduce and control methane and potential nitrous oxide emissions during inundation required for crops such as (narrowleaf) cattail and azolla. Paludiculture can provide ecosystem services related to water management and nutrient status, as well as raw materials for a bio-based economy. Gradual transitions in space and time between farming and nature can be envisaged, providing incentives to diversify land use in the Dutch peatlands. This case study identifies key questions and provides valuable insights for peatland management worldwide. Reducing land subsidence and greenhouse gas emissions from peatlands is feasible, but requires thoughtful interventions that cautiously make and align trade-offs between various interests and uncertainties.
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球范围内，泥炭地因人工排水导致泥炭分解，遭受地面沉降和温室气体排放问题。在人为气候变化背景下，这些问题需要采取措施减少温室气体排放，并保护低洼地区免受日益增加的洪水风险。需要更严格地控制地下水位，既要在现有农业系统内进行，也要通过开发适合高地下水位或淹水条件下耕作的新型农业系统。该问题的复杂性和价值负载性要求制定一份关于措施潜在影响和副作用的全面概述。本文基于混合方法，针对特殊案例——荷兰，综合了这样一份概述。荷兰泥炭地包括该国低洼的西部和北部的大片土地。该案例的特殊之处在于，这些泥炭地大部分位于海平面以下，支撑着世界级的集约化奶牛养殖，并面临多重其他环境、经济和社会挑战。在此，地面沉降增加了洪水风险、盐水入侵和水管理成本，尤其是在全球气候变化下。为缓解地面沉降，可以设想技术措施和替代性土地利用方式。然而，关于这些的文献较为分散，使得仔细识别和选择措施变得复杂。为解决这一知识空白，我们回顾了27项技术措施和替代性土地利用选项，并综合了15种效应的证据和见解。允许现有奶牛养殖继续的技术措施为农民提供了相对低风险的干预措施，但只能减少而非停止地面沉降和温室气体排放。替代性土地利用选项，特别是湿地农业，正处于发展的起步阶段，可以停止地面沉降。然而，需要更多研究来减少和控制淹水期间（如窄叶香蒲和满江红等作物所需）的甲烷和潜在的一氧化二氮排放。湿地农业可以提供与水管理和养分状况相关的生态系统服务，以及生物基经济的原材料。可以设想在空间和时间上逐步在农业和自然之间过渡，为荷兰泥炭地土地利用多样化提供激励。本案例研究确定了关键问题，并为全球泥炭地管理提供了宝贵见解。减少泥炭地的地面沉降和温室气体排放是可行的，但需要深思熟虑的干预措施，谨慎地制定并协调各种利益和不确定性之间的权衡。

articles.title_en: Still suffering, still on the periphery? Different paths of the town's post-war spatial change. Evidence from north-eastern Poland
articles.title_cn: 仍在受苦，仍在边缘？城镇战后空间变迁的不同路径——来自波兰东北部的证据
articles.abstract_en: The scale of destruction of many historical cities due to the warfare of World War II and the varied directions of spatial transformation during the post-war political and economic uncertainty period in Poland was unprecedented. As a result, in many cities, we are confronted with a significant differentiation in the character of the development of central areas and numerous spatial and functional problems. The main objective of the study is to present the results of a comparative study of the varied forms and effects of rebuilding the historic centres of small towns in northeastern Poland after World War II. Small towns were selected because of their peripheral character to the large centres rebuilt in the first place. Out of a group of 17 towns in the Warmian-Masurian voivodeship destroyed in at least 70 %, three case studies with different land use policy approach were chosen. The paper proposes an original research model based on different spatial scales of analysis and quantitative and qualitative research methods of the built-up area. For this purpose field studies, graph method, built-up areas and planning document analyses based on contemporary and archival materials in a GIS environment were used. The results allowed for the classification of the directions of the post-war urban recovery and construction of case-study models of reconstruction based on neointegration (Węgorzewo), conditional restructuring (Lubawa) and the model of an unbuilt-up town (Kisielice). Our findings indicate that the negative consequences of the spatial transformations (e.g., spatial chaos, lack of a functional and spatial centre, unbuilt quarters and limited effectiveness of planning and revitalisation tools) are still felt today despite the corrective measures taken. They also suggest a need for local and regional debate on the needs and possibilities for further revitalisation of the study area and a recovery programme developed at the national level.
articles.abstract_cn: 第二次世界大战造成的许多历史城市的破坏规模以及波兰战后政治经济不确定时期空间转型的不同方向是前所未有的。因此，在许多城市，我们面临着中心区域发展特征的显著差异以及众多的空间和功能问题。本研究的主要目的是呈现对波兰东北部小城镇历史中心在第二次世界大战后重建的不同形式和效果的比较研究结果。选择小城镇是因为它们相对于首先重建的大型中心具有边缘性。在瓦尔米亚-马祖里省被摧毁至少70%的17个城镇中，选择了三个具有不同土地利用政策方法的案例研究。本文提出了一种基于不同空间尺度分析和建成区定量与定性研究方法的研究模型。为此，使用了实地研究、图形方法、建成区和规划文件分析，基于当代和档案材料在GIS环境中进行。结果允许对战后城市恢复方向进行分类，并构建基于新整合（文戈热沃）、有条件重组（卢巴瓦）和未建成城镇模型（基谢利采）的重建案例研究模型。我们的发现表明，空间转型的负面后果（例如，空间混乱、缺乏功能和空间中心、未建成的街区以及规划和振兴工具的有效性有限）尽管采取了纠正措施，至今仍能感受到。它们还表明，需要在地方和区域层面就研究区域进一步振兴的需求和可能性进行辩论，并制定国家层面的恢复计划。
